meta.title: Lenix Finance | Collateral Lending & Liquidity
meta.description: Borrow against approved crypto collateral or supply liquidity on Lenix Finance. LTV, rates, and liquidation thresholds shown before you commit.
meta.keywords: Crypto Lending, Collateral Loans, DeFi Liquidity, Lenix Finance, Crypto-to-Fiat

Hero.subtitle: Borrow stablecoins or fiat against approved assets, or supply liquidity to the protocol — with LTV, rates, and health factors visible before you sign.

Steps.title: How it works
Steps.description: From wallet connection to funded loan or supplied liquidity — three steps with clear terms upfront.

wallet.title: Connect your wallet
wallet.description: Use Lenix Wallet or connect an supported wallet to access lending and supply flows.

apply.title: Review terms
apply.description: Choose collateral, see LTV, repayment schedule, and liquidation thresholds before submitting.

draw.title: Draw or supply
draw.description: Receive a loan disbursement or supply assets to earn from borrower interest — withdraw when liquidity allows.

Markets.title: Market overview
Markets.description: Indicative rates and liquidity across supported assets. Confirm live values in the app before transacting.

collateral.title: Collateralized borrowing
collateral.desc: Draw stablecoins or fiat against approved vault collateral — without selling the underlying asset. Credit checks are not required for eligible collateral types.

ltv.title: LTV shown upfront
ltv.desc: Loan-to-value, repayment schedule, and liquidation thresholds are displayed before disbursement — not adjusted silently after you sign.

liquidity.title: Supply and earn
liquidity.desc: Provide liquidity to the protocol and earn from borrower interest. Withdraw when pool liquidity is available — no fixed lock-up term.

Calculator.title: Estimate your returns
Calculator.description: Model supply-side yield at current indicative APYs. Actual returns depend on utilization, rates, and how long assets remain supplied.

yield.a: Borrowers pay interest on loans. A portion is distributed to liquidity providers after the protocol reserve. Rates move with pool utilization — check the app for current APY.

lockup.a: No fixed term for suppliers. You can withdraw when the pool has sufficient liquidity. During high utilization, withdrawals may queue until borrowers repay.

liquidation.q: What happens if my loan health factor falls?
liquidation.a: If collateral value drops below the agreed LTV, liquidation may occur to repay outstanding debt. Health factor and liquidation price are shown in the dashboard before and during the loan.

fees.a: Protocol fees are reflected in the net APY or loan terms shown at application. On-chain gas for deposits, borrows, and withdrawals is separate and paid to the network.

Cta.title: Ready to borrow or supply?
Cta.description: Apply for a collateral loan or open the app to supply liquidity. Support is available if you need help scoping terms.
